lane: CI TIMING (speed and reliability: the voice's first word, video, the games' brains, the shared checks)

features.name: Hands-free conversation
features.does: Ghosty listens, answers aloud, and the ear opens again on its own after each reply, so ten turns need one tap
features.note: His first spoken word comes about 0.8 to 0.95 seconds after he stops; the check holds it under one second

features.name: "Ghosty listen" from Siri
features.where: Settings → Shortcuts → Ghosty listen (a Siri shortcut)
features.does: Opens Ghosty on Home already listening, as if he had tapped the mic
features.note: There is no always-on wake word inside Ghosty itself: Siri or a tap starts it

features.name: Talking over Ghosty
features.does: Ghosty goes quiet within about 40 ms, marks the reply as cut, and "go on" carries on from the sentence he was in

features.name: Saying what he is doing while he works
features.does: While the brain works, a short line in plain words ("reading that page…") shows under his words, and is said aloud in spoken turns but never in typed ones
features.note: The early check on the final commit showed it waiting on the security lane's local-test fix; it passed once that landed

features.name: The line under his words
features.does: One line says where the turn is: Sending…, Asking my brain…, the step at work, Writing it now…, or Stopped

features.name: Read aloud (books and pages)
features.where: Library → a book → LISTEN, or say it
features.does: Reads a book or page aloud, remembers the sentence he stopped at, and picks up from there
features.note: The first word comes about half a second after asking

features.name: Notices read in turn
features.does: Reminders and notices are read after the greeting or a reply, never over them

features.name: Cooling down, said aloud
say: (any question while his models are resting)
features.does: If every model is resting, he says so in one sentence with the time the first is back, then answers at that time

features.name: Choosing the voice
features.does: Ghosty's own voice, or the phone's voice as the fallback, with a sample line

features.name: Knowing it is his voice
features.does: The phone recognises his voice as a convenience; it stays on the phone and is never a lock
features.note: The voice lane made the brain aware of it

features.name: A quick board-game opponent
features.where: ARCADE → draughts, othello, backgammon or connect four
features.does: Ghosty answers a move within his thinking time (about half a second at level 1), and the board never freezes
features.note: Before today's fix, a slow screen made it take about 4 seconds

features.name: Video export on any phone
say: (tap EXPORT; exporting by voice is refused on purpose)
features.does: Writes the video frame by frame where the phone can; otherwise records it in real time, and that file is now always as long as the timeline
features.note: The real-time file is .mp4 or .webm, depending on the phone

features.name: Exact scrubbing and steadying
features.does: Every seek shows the frame under the playhead, so steadying and scrubbing are exact

upward.idea: Start speaking on the first sentence while the rest is still arriving
upward.why: His first word comes about a third of a second sooner on long answers
upward.builds_on: Replies already arrive a sentence at a time, and the voice already queues sentences

upward.idea: Keep the connection to the brain warm during a conversation
upward.why: Removes the slower first turn after opening (today about 1 second, against about 0.85 seconds after that)
upward.builds_on: The status call already made when a conversation starts

upward.idea: A speed meter in Settings → System
upward.why: He sees his own first-word, answer and ear-reopening times from the last day, kept on the phone
upward.builds_on: The timings the talk checks already measure

upward.idea: Draw nothing while nothing moves, on every screen
upward.why: Longer battery, a cooler phone, and none of the second-long freezes after a screen opens (the board-game fix, applied everywhere)

upward.idea: A sign that the end of his speech was heard
upward.why: A soft tick tells him he was heard, so he never wonders whether to say it again
upward.builds_on: The ear's end-of-speech detection and the "your turn" tone

upward.idea: Answer short things aloud even with no signal
upward.why: Yes or no, the time and timers are answered aloud with no signal
upward.builds_on: The brain on the phone and the phone's own voice

upward.idea: Faster video export on more phones
upward.why: Videos are made quicker than real time on more phones
upward.builds_on: The existing frame-by-frame route and Ghosty's own file writer

upward.idea: Export in the background, with progress in a notification
upward.why: He can leave the editor while a long video is being made

upward.idea: Board games that think during his turn
upward.why: Ghosty's answer is instant on the easy levels
upward.builds_on: The board-game helper that already searches off the main screen

upward.why: If Ghosty's voice fails mid-reply, the phone's voice carries on from the same sentence with no silence
upward.builds_on: The voice already hands what it could not say to the phone's voice

upward.idea: A nightly check-up of the slow paths
upward.why: Finds a slowdown before he does and tells him in plain words
upward.builds_on: Night School and the health marks

upward.why: Each screen opens from what is kept on the phone, then updates
upward.builds_on: What each screen already keeps on the phone

sideways.why: "Next step", "repeat" and "set a timer" without touching the phone, with every step read aloud

sideways.idea: Hear my document read aloud while I edit it
sideways.why: Hearing his own writing catches mistakes

sideways.idea: A spoken guide to any screen
sideways.why: "What can I do here?" answered aloud, step by step
sideways.builds_on: The list of everything he can do, and narration

sideways.idea: Voice notes that become text on the phone
sideways.why: Quick notes by voice, kept on the phone
sideways.builds_on: The microphone and the phone's own speech recognition

sideways.why: "Column four" or "take with the left piece", with the move said back
sideways.builds_on: The board games and the conversation loop

sideways.idea: Practise a speech, with the pace and pauses timed
sideways.why: Coaching from his own voice only, with the timing measured
sideways.builds_on: Rehearse, the ear's speech detection and the timing tools

sideways.why: He records narration straight onto the timeline, and the music dips under it
sideways.builds_on: The video editor's voice-over track and the microphone

sideways.why: Subtitles from his own spoken words, made on the phone

sideways.idea: A read-aloud queue for the commute
sideways.why: Saved articles read one after another, with his place kept

sideways.idea: Offer to steady shaky clips when they are added
sideways.why: Shaky clips fixed with one yes

cross.idea: The radio fades under Ghosty while he speaks, and comes back after
The Lens reads aloud what it sees (text, signs, labels) the moment he points it
cross.why: Reading without looking, in one gesture

cross.idea: School's tutor teaches as a spoken lesson that he can interrupt
cross.why: He can stop it to ask a question, the way a real tutor allows

cross.idea: Comic panels read aloud, with a voice he picks for each character
The morning brief read aloud when he says "Ghosty listen" before 9
cross.why: His day as a hands-free briefing, read a sentence at a time

cross.idea: Game-studio games drawn only when something changes
cross.why: His own games run smoothly and stay cool on the phone
